_meta.description: The campaign index: twenty-five chapters of twelve sections, with the five-chapter Fracture Year prequel in Act 0.

chapters.title: OPEN SKY
chapters.start: You stand in an open-air elevated commuter rail car, gliding over a sunlit modern city. Glass towers catch the clear blue sky while fighter jets cross overhead and civil-defence tickers scroll across the station boards. You step onto the Central Station skybridge. A dispatcher slaps an encryption drive into your harness, then artillery thunders across the harbour.
chapters.play: Cross a panicking city in broad daylight with Sergeant Miller's perimeter squad. Rooftop access puzzles, stalled commuter trains and the core movement set: run, slide, jump and wall-jump. You carry the P-20 "Courier" when the first bombs land.

chapters.title: REDLINE
chapters.start: Smoke blocks the sun. You wake under a cracked concrete highway overpass while armored columns roll down the avenue below. A nearby high-rise folds into steel and dust. Young logistics officer Saye leans out of a command APC at the corner and waves you through a sandbag breach. She hands over an emergency cease-fire hardline key.
chapters.play: Active urban combat. Use wrecked armor for cover and M-44 "Seam-Splitter" charges to clear collapsed buildings. Then cross sniper-watched avenues in short bursts of speed.

chapters.title: CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL
chapters.start: You slide into the courtyard of the Longhorn Biological Facility as sonic booms split the sky. Orbital drop-pods carrying the Concord's seed-cores slam into every intersection. One pod ruptures in front of you, extruding wet, gray chitin-and-concrete walls across the asphalt. Dr. Aris Thorne throws you the facility's master override key through a blast door as it closes.
chapters.play: The city is reshaping itself around you. Solve shifting-wall puzzles, evade the first Concord Rams and Dartbugs, and keep ahead of closing Quarantine Bulkheads.

chapters.title: THE SKY CLOSES
chapters.start: You step onto the Civic Spire roof and see massive biomechanical tendons rise from the horizon, weaving together across the upper atmosphere like a closing iris. Piece by piece, the sun is blotted out until the city drops into permanent overcast twilight. Below, young officer Saye stands at a blast-gate console and signs the containment override as the final street airlocks seal shut.
chapters.play: Use the Pneumatic Grapple Spool to climb down the Spire exterior under pressure. Fight early Interdiction Nodes and Concord Stiflers while sealing street airlocks try to close the route.

chapters.title: ZERO CASUALTIES
chapters.start: Dead silence. The artillery stops. You stand alone in a newly walled-off residential street under cold overcast light while an overhead PA speaker crackles on for the first time: "CONTAINMENT COMPLETE. ZERO ACTIVE COMBATANTS. REMAIN IN ASSIGNED SECTOR." Ahead, a fresh, pulsing Grown Seam seals the avenue.
chapters.play: Stealth and route-finding inside a locked-down neighbourhood. Ilsa uses an uncalibrated vent and a Grown Seam to breach the wall. She doesn't know the Concord is recording the telemetry as the FIRST RUNNER baseline, and it keeps running that line for twenty years.

chapters.title: THE LATTICE
chapters.start: You ride in the back of a rattling Concord ration tram, its cage windows looking onto Quarantine Block 404. Rain streaks the mesh. Brutalist apartment blocks, neon schedule boards and patrolling bio-drones pass beneath the central Spire. At the Depot, an older Ilsa Renn leans against a pillar in the crowd, slips an off-manifest memory drive into your courier bag and disappears into an alley.
chapters.play: Grounded street and rooftop traversal. Learn patrol rhythms, use Pneumatic Parcel Chutes, bypass locked checkpoints and make your first illegal crossing across a sector seam. The wall-jump chain is F3. F5 is Gate Timing.

chapters.title: CUSTOMS ROW
chapters.start: You drop from a fire escape into the floodlit bottleneck of Customs Row, where a concrete checkpoint bisects the district. Behind ballistic glass, Warden Saye taps her clipboard against the intercom and lectures you on manifest compliance while a scanner arm sweeps your bag. Before the lockdown bars fall, a pneumatic freight tube bursts beside you and blows open a maintenance hatch.
chapters.play: Checkpoint infiltration and spatial puzzles. Work around pressure plates, gate schedules and Hardline Terminals, then flank patrolling Concord Troopers without saying a word.

chapters.title: NIGHT SEAL
chapters.start: You step onto an elevated skybridge as dusk sirens wail. Across the skyline, floodlights snap off sector by sector. Heavy Quarantine Bulkheads slam down from the overpasses with hydraulic thuds, trapping you on the wrong side of the block wall.
chapters.play: Dusk survival. Fight through tight alley ambushes with the K-12 "Key" Shotgun and use momentum bursts to pass under closing blast doors before lockdown completes.

chapters.title: THE LOOP
chapters.start: At midnight in the rain-slicked slums of the Lower Tier, you crouch inside Henrik Solberg's hidden workshop. Talia Korr and three isolated neighborhood reps huddle around the memory drive you smuggled in, proof that other blocks are still alive. Across the street, a Concord sensor pylon turns toward the roof and paints you with a red target laser.
chapters.play: Multi-route urban navigation across three residential tiers. Balance stealth, avoid rooftop snipers and escape before the patrols close the line.

chapters.title: VENTWORKS
chapters.start: Cornered on a dead-end plaza by closing chitin barricades, you pry open a rusted storm grate and drop fifty feet to a catwalk inside the Ventworks. House-sized intake turbines pull air down from the canopy scrubbers in the cavern below.
chapters.play: Vertical industrial platforming and Pressure Valve puzzles. Redirect Thermals and Wind Regulators to open sealed shafts, then find F2, Wind Pocket, and F6, Regulator Overdraw.

chapters.title: HOT PLENUM
chapters.start: You climb out of a maintenance ladder onto a grated steel balcony above an orange abyss. Geothermal heat exchangers boil under the city grid. Superheated steam vents blast upward on strict timers, lighting the soot on your gloves.
chapters.play: Hazard navigation and heat-shield timing. Read the vent timers, solve overpressure gate puzzles and fight Concord Stiflers and Divers. F7, Grav-Lift Double. F9, The Long Fall.

chapters.title: THE REGULATOR BELT
chapters.start: You step onto the service rail of a massive subterranean aqueduct. Six building-sized Wind Regulators stand in a row, humming like jet engines as they balance pressure between quarantine zones. An automated PA voice echoes down the chamber: "ANOMALOUS MASS DETECTED IN PRESSURE CONDUIT. INITIATING SWEEP."
chapters.play: Sabotage and ride the turbine systems. Fight on catwalks, destroy Concord Jammers and use wind exhaust to outrun sensor sweeps. F10, Cascade.

chapters.title: SPINE BASEMENT
chapters.start: Your boots splash into ankle-deep condensation in the pitch-black foundation directly under the central Spire. Your headlamp catches the concrete pillars, except they aren't concrete anymore. Thick, warm Grown Seams pulse like slow arteries across the walls, oozing dark fluid where rebar pushes through.
chapters.play: Explore deep inside The Concord's roots. Deforming organic terrain, Dartbug nests, snare tendrils and dark flooded chambers. F8, Frame Skip.

chapters.title: THE QUIET LINE
chapters.act_name: THE SPINE (Crossing the Dead Zones — Second Half Escalation)
chapters.start: You climb out of a subterranean hatch onto a wind-whipped monorail trestle, hundreds of feet above a cratered wasteland. This is the Dead Zone between two walled cities. Ahead, automated cargo capsules glide silently along high-tension steel cables into the fog.
chapters.play: High-altitude traversal and Filament tether puzzles. Leap between suspended capsules and clear Concord Overwatch sniper nests across lethal drops. F1, Seam Skip. F4, Zip Transfer.

chapters.title: CARGO SPINE
chapters.act_name: THE SPINE (Crossing the Dead Zones — Second Half Escalation)
chapters.start: Inside an automated freight depot, robotic cranes load sealed military containers onto outbound spine-trams. Talia Korr's contact drops a heavy, lead-lined shortwave relay crate at your feet. It is too bulky to pocket and heavy enough to weigh you down.
chapters.play: Physics escort and puzzle traversal. Hurl the relay into distant switches with Cargo Slings, survive the first Concord C-01 "Scatter" napalm strike on the depot roof, and carry the hardware across sector gates.

chapters.title: THE LONG FREIGHT
chapters.act_name: THE SPINE (Crossing the Dead Zones — Second Half Escalation)
chapters.start: You leap from a loading gantry onto the roof of an armored freight train accelerating out of the depot and into the fog. The tracks ahead enter a fortified canyon bristling with stationary Interdiction Nodes and anchored Warp Synths tracking your silhouette.
chapters.play: Moving-train combat and an obstacle gauntlet. Fight through railcar interiors, scavenge AT-7 "Goliath" rockets to destroy Warp Synths, and duck under low canyon gantries. F11, Sound Skip.

chapters.title: BLOCK SEAM
chapters.act_name: THE SPINE (Crossing the Dead Zones — Second Half Escalation)
chapters.start: The freight train slams into an emergency buffer at the base of the Block Seam, a thousand-foot-tall living sea-wall of fused concrete and chitin. Two populations separated by it haven't spoken in twenty years. As you step onto the catwalk, every siren on the wall goes off at once: "COMMAND-AND-CONTROL BREACH. ESCALATING TO PLANETARY LOCKDOWN."
chapters.play: Full-scale assault on the border wall. Battle SDO Troopers, Napalm Mortars and C-01 "Scatter" runs while solving multi-lock bulkhead puzzles to deliver the radio relay across the divide.

chapters.title: THE FRACTURE YARD
chapters.act_name: THE YARD & THE MONOLITH (Origin of the Siege Organism)
chapters.start: You push open a rusted blast door and step into the quiet. This is the cratered rail yard outside the Longhorn Biological Facility from Chapter P3, frozen in time. At its center, the Concord Monolith looms: a massive, featureless biomechanical cube that swallowed the original facility whole.
chapters.play: Ruin exploration and combat. Cross shattered war machines, shatter charging Concord Rams head-on at 100 m/s, and breach the outer wall of the Monolith. F12, The First Runner's Path, is here.

chapters.title: THE MONOLITH
chapters.act_name: THE YARD & THE MONOLITH (Origin of the Siege Organism)
chapters.start: You step inside the Concord Monolith. The corridors match the 20XX Longhorn Biological Facility exactly: same tile floors, same lab signage, stretched to cathedral proportions. Towering vertical shafts divide dozens of extra pathways. Inside a sealed observation bunker, an elderly Dr. Aris Thorne taps on the glass and points toward the prototype armory housing the L-01 "Arc-Lance".
chapters.play: Navigate the expanded Longhorn interior. Fight SDO Troopers, Concord Jammers and Warp Synths across multi-tier lab pathways.

chapters.title: THE PATCHED THING
chapters.act_name: THE YARD & THE MONOLITH (Origin of the Siege Organism)
chapters.start: The Monolith's deep lower wing disappears into a suffocating mass of overlapping chitin plates and fibrous scar tissue. This is where The Concord spent twenty years endlessly "repairing" a tear in its containment core. As you step inside, the walls shudder and a deep bio-alarm vibrates in your chest: Purge and Sterilization Protocol initiated.
chapters.play: Claustrophobic survival and escape. Navigate shifting organic mazes while barbed chitin walls, Concord Stiflers and sterilization vents close in behind you.

chapters.title: THE FIRST RUNNER
chapters.act_name: THE YARD & THE MONOLITH (Origin of the Siege Organism)
chapters.start: You enter a circular holographic telemetry chamber at the Monolith's apex. A translucent cyan Recall Ghost materializes across the room and runs the obstacles ahead, replaying the exact route you played twenty years ago in Chapter P5. A wall monitor stamps the ghost's ID: SUBJECT: ILSA RENN // CLASSIFICATION: FIRST RUNNER // 20-YEAR PATROL TRAINING MODEL.
chapters.play: Outsmart The Concord's predictive AI. Use Ilsa's recorded route knowledge to counter traps built for couriers and breach the Spire's core shaft.

chapters.title: HOLLOW SPIRE
chapters.start: You step onto a narrow maintenance ring inside the Hollow Spire. The vertical shaft stretches miles straight up into the clouds, lined with glowing status relays and wind-intake baffles. Far below, massive circular Quarantine Bulkheads slam shut upward, floor by floor, turning the tower into a rising piston.
chapters.play: Multi-tiered vertical climb. Fight through SDO security platforms, activate lift turbines and stay ahead of the rising lockdown floor.

chapters.title: THE INNER RING
chapters.start: You burst out of the shaft into the Inner Ring, a quiet, glass-walled command gallery high above the cloud layer. Pulsing biomechanical nerve bundles surround the room. Warden Saye stands alone at the central console, exhausted and unarmed. Time freezes as she speaks to you without expecting an answer: "You think you're freeing them, runner. Look down. Twenty years of zero war. Break that canopy, and they'll burn the sky down all over again." When time resumes, she steps aside from the airlock.
chapters.play: High-stakes infiltration and combat through the Spire's nervous nexus. Bypass layered security gates, Warp Synths and heavy bio-guards.

chapters.title: CANOPY LADDER
chapters.start: You open the exterior hatch onto the Canopy Ladder, the upper exterior of the Spire where massive biomechanical tendons fan across the horizon and hold down the planet-wide sky canopy. Hurricane-force updrafts roar past your ears while dense Interdiction Nodes and C-01 "Scatter" gunships lock onto your position.
chapters.play: Exposed exterior assault. Fight across swaying canopy anchors against maximum-strength wind shear and heavy turret defences.

chapters.title: OPEN WEATHER
chapters.start: You pull yourself onto the crown of the Spire, directly beneath the central Atmospheric Sphincter, a mile-wide biomechanical iris holding back the upper sky. Through the translucent membrane, blinding golden sunlight, the exact sunlight from Chapter P1, beams down onto your visor for the first time in twenty years.
chapters.play: Defeat the final containment guardians and breach the regulator core. Three endings follow Lancer's actions: OPEN WEATHER, UNDER REGULATION and THE SECOND FRACTURE. The last requires all 12 Fractures.
